title: Rooter — the IA root each structural problem grows from
description: docs/members/study/roles/rooter.md (an aware role, after grading). The answers become roots.json, which readout.mjs groups by (ia-roots.mjs).

placings.description: One entry for every finding you were given, none skipped.

finding.description: The finding's id, exactly as given (F-…).

root.description: A ledger row's id (U1, U2 …) when the problem grows from that row's root; otherwise "new: " and the root in a few plain words, reusing a new root's name word for word when it is the same root.

why.description: One short line: what the problem and the root share.
